entities.summary: Ton Satomi  is the pen-name of Japanese author Hideo Yamanouchi . Satomi was known for the craftsmanship of his dialogue and command of the Japanese language. His two elder brothers, Ikuma Arishima and Takeo Arishima, were also authors.
